name: Hand-drawn chart proves the same team does more
looks: On the dark ground a simple hand-drawn axis chart draws itself: a flat, slightly wavering line labelled 'same team' sits low, while a smooth curve above it climbs steadily to a dot labelled 'more bids' with a checkmark, a soft crossed-out label marking what the flat line used to mean.
build: easing-graph-draw's progressive lineTo reveal for both the flat comparison line and the rising curve, the curve in the accent colour only; the end dot and checkmark pop in with a small spring once the curve finishes drawing.
sound: A quiet bed with a tick per unit along the curve, and a confirm chime on the checkmark.
prompt: Prove a result with a simple honest chart, not a dashboard: draw a flat comparison line low in the frame labelled with what stayed the same, then draw a smooth rising curve above it in the accent colour, ending on a checkmarked dot that names the thing that improved.
